Built for easy living

Electric heating with touch screen and Wi-Fi control. Set the temperature from your phone and it holds it, ready for when you arrive.

The controls on one of our electric tubs. LED, jets and air, each on its own switch at the tub side.

Jets and LED lighting

Hydromassage jets throughout and soft LED lighting under the water, for the full experience after dark.

What is included, either tub
  • Thermowood tub with stainless steel banding
  • Electric heating with full touch screen control
  • Wi-Fi app control, heat the water before you arrive
  • Jets and LED lighting
  • Insulated thermo lid included
  • Timber steps included
  • Fibreglass insert in your choice of colour

Handcrafted in Wales

Thermowood cladding, heat treated for the outdoors and bound in stainless steel. The same care that goes into your barrel sauna goes into the tub.
